name: 1-Lipschitz Proxy Node Construction
definition: A proxy node replaces a sub-tree's signed distance function with a simpler field v over a region Ω, ensuring the resulting function fe is 1-Lipschitz continuous by interpolating between the original field f and the proxy field v using a weighting function α(p).
summary: This method constructs a simplified signed distance function proxy that explicitly interpolates between the original field and a simpler proxy to guarantee 1-Lipschitz continuity for safe hierarchical pruning.
